patch_description: This crossover retains the current program’s strongest regularization choice—one shared circuit parameter—but replaces its poorly separating tied ZZ/RX dynamics with the higher-performing collective RY/RZ basis transformation and parameter-free Möbius-ladder entangler. The resulting model still has only one distinct circuit angle and three total trainable parameters including readout calibration, while the cyclic and long-range connectivity improves correlation transport and robust held-out separation.
